card.name: Partway through abbreviations and numbers
card.fires_on: Mid-item pieces just before the item completes: the 'of' before a name or unit, a letter inside a dotted abbreviation (D.V.M., N.M.), the last digit of a dose range in mCi, or an inner syllable of a long word.

modes.label: Dotted abbreviations
modes.description: A letter inside a dotted degree or state abbreviation, before the next letter and period.

modes.label: Dose range digits
modes.description: A digit inside a radioactivity dose range or value in mCi or MBq.
modes.example: Administer 296-444 MBq (8-1<<2>> mCi) as an intravenous injection

modes.label: Inside long words or 'of' phrases
modes.description: A syllable inside a long word, or 'of' before a fixed name or unit.
modes.example: A nanometer is a billionth<< of>> a meter
